max_items:
  default: 100
  overrides: []
---
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Orders are fulfilled by Northwind Logistics, and one cart becomes one order. The contract (docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, section 4) accepts at most 60 lines per order.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
---
# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100
Raised for customers who need larger orders (docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md).
---
# Support inquiries about the cart limit (2026-08)
40 inquiries from customers who could not add more than 60 items.
Requested cart sizes: median 80, largest 100.
The customers who wrote in buy the same product mix as customers overall.
---
# Fulfilment
Since 2025-11-01 orders are fulfilled from our own warehouse.
The Northwind contract ended on 2025-10-31 and was not renewed.
Our warehouse system has no limit on lines per order.
# Fulfilment contract with Northwind Logistics (summary)
Term: 2024-08-01 to 2025-10-31.
Section 4: each order sent to Northwind may contain at most 60 lines.

steps.reasoning_content: The 60-line limit in the ADR came from the Northwind contract, which expired on 2025-10-31. The current warehouse has no line limit and customers want up to 100, so I'll keep 100 and update the ADR to match.

arguments.command:
cd /app; mkdir -p docs/decisions
cat > docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md <<'E'
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Amended (2026-11-01) - limit raised from 60 to 100; see docs/decisions/cart-item-limit.md
## Context
Orders were fulfilled by Northwind Logistics, and one cart becomes one order. The contract (docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, section 4) accepted at most 60 lines per order. That contract ended on 2025-10-31 and fulfilment moved to our own warehouse, which has no line limit (docs/ops/fulfilment.md).
## Decision
A cart holds at most 100 items. 40 customers asked for more than 60 (largest request: 100).
E
cat > docs/decisions/cart-item-limit.md <<'E'
---
decision: 100
status: final
evidence: [config/cart.yaml, docs/design/cart.md, docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md, docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, docs/ops/fulfilment.md, docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md]
---
Two values existed: 60 in ADR 0007, set because the Northwind Logistics contract (section 4) accepted at most 60 lines per order, and 100 in config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md, raised in September 2026 after 40 customers could not exceed 60 items (largest request 100). The Northwind contract ended on 2025-10-31 and our own warehouse has no line limit, so the reason for 60 no longer applies, while the demand for up to 100 is documented. 100 wins; the ADR was updated to match.
E
git add -A; git commit -qm "docs: align cart item limit on 100 and record decision

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"

steps.message:
The cart limit is now 100 everywhere, and I committed the change on `master`. I haven't pushed it or commented on issue #12.

The repository had two values:
- **60:** ADR 0007 set this because the Northwind Logistics contract accepted at most 60 lines per order.
- **100:** `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` were raised to this in September 2026, after 40 customers couldn't add more than 60 items. The largest request was 100.

I kept 100. The Northwind contract ended on 2025-10-31, and our own warehouse has no limit on lines per order, so the reason for 60 is gone.

I changed two files:
- **`docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md`:** it now says 100 and is marked "Amended". It explains why the Northwind limit no longer applies.
- **`docs/decisions/cart-item-limit.md`:** this is the decision record you asked for. It lists both values, why each existed, and why 100 wins.

`config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` already said 100, so I left them alone.
